description:
List Members of a Network

List the resources attached to a specific [Network](#tag/networks).

Use the provided URI parameters to modify the result.

page.description: Page number to return. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

per_page.description: Maximum number of entries returned per page. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

sort.description:
Sort resources by field and direction. May be used multiple times.

For more information, see "[Sorting](#description/sorting)".

status.description:
Filter members by status. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain members matching the specified statuses.

items.description: Status of the resource within the [Network](#tag/networks).

x-enumDescriptions.attaching: The resource is being attached to the [Network](#tag/networks).
x-enumDescriptions.detaching: The resource is being detached from the [Network](#tag/networks).
x-enumDescriptions.error: The last operation on this member failed. Its network configuration might be out of date, and the resource might not be reachable within the [Network](#tag/networks) as expected.
x-enumDescriptions.ok: The resource is attached and its network configuration is up to date.
x-enumDescriptions.updating: The resource network configuration is being updated.

subnet.description:
Filter members by the subnet they are attached to. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain members attached to the subnets with the
specified IP ranges. Uses CIDR notation.

type.description:
Filter members by type. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain members matching the specified types.

items.description: Type of the resource attached to the [Network](#tag/networks).

name: hcloud_get_network_members
